card.name: Digits in organ dose tables
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number, most often a leading 0 before a decimal point, in rows of organ-by-organ radiation dose tables. It also fires weakly on a few list separators such as / or 'or' between numbered options.

modes.label: Leading digit in organ tables
modes.description: A leading 0 or other first digit of a decimal value following an organ name like Thymus, Spleen or Skin.

modes.label: Separators in lists of options
modes.description: A slash or 'or' joining the last items in a short list of categories or numbers.

card.plain: It marks the start of a number in a table of radiation doses to organs.
